metrics.argument: With the exact linear FP32 accumulator, a remote accumulator must visit the source to deliver the result. To allow at most one off-card edge along any expert-result path, every operand consumed at the remote site must originate on its card, and no second remote site may follow. Only an original consecutive prefix can be computed there. Return its FP32 state or, after all 6 slots, final BF16. Once at source, remaining operands arrive directly. Applies only to whole-width vectors, fixed expert placement and this arithmetic chain; control/weights are outside this depth bound.
